title: Support documented standard gesture mappings

statement.en: Use each standard gesture's familiar action on the Apple platforms documented for that gesture.
statement.ja: 標準ジェスチャーは、それぞれに対応すると資料に記載されたAppleプラットフォームで、使い慣れた操作に対応させる。

conditions: Tap activates/selects, swipe reveals/dismisses/scrolls, and drag moves a UI element on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS.
Touch or pinch and hold reveals controls on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS; macOS is not listed for this row.
Double tap supports zooming on the listed platforms; the table names Apple Watch Series 9 and Ultra 2 for a primary action, not as an exhaustive current hardware list.
Zoom and rotate apply to iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS; watchOS is not listed for those rows.
These mappings apply when the corresponding action is relevant; they do not require every app to implement every action.
